audit.reason: If the input root contains units, the first ordinary-elimination stage is reached only after one or more exact unit-propagation/restriction steps. The correct object is therefore the first unit-free ordinary residual, not necessarily the byte-identical input root.

generic_lemma.state: Any canonical unit-free CNF F at an ordinary-elimination stage, with s=state_units(F).
generic_lemma.proof_identity: With A=2p+U_plus, B=2q+U_minus, X=pq+qU_plus+pU_minus and unit-free U_plus>=p,U_minus>=q: A*B-3X=(U_plus-p)(U_minus-q)>=0.

definitions.F1: the first residual on the frozen run at which ordinary elimination is attempted, before any ordinary or extension transition; F1 may equal G or be obtained from G solely by exact unit propagation/restriction

first_ordinary_state_corollary.statement: Every live pivot in F1 is raw-cap safe under the frozen original-root cap N^2.
proof: Unit propagation/restriction and canonicalization introduce no new clauses/literals and therefore state_units(F1)<=state_units(G)=N-r0.
F1 is unit-free by solver order; otherwise unit propagation would run again before ordinary elimination.
A mixed pivot has RAW<=1+(state_units(F1)-1)^2/12 <= 1+(N-r0-1)^2/12 < N^2.
Thus every live pivot offered to first_capped_elimination in this first ordinary state is cap-safe; the deterministic lowest-ID scan does not depend on finding a special low-degree pivot.

first_ordinary_projection_envelope.statement: If F1 proceeds by mixed-pivot ordinary elimination, its next canonical residual F2 satisfies state_units(F2)<=1+(state_units(F1)-1)^2/12<=1+(N-r0-1)^2/12. If the chosen pivot is pure, state_units(F2)<=state_units(F1)<=N-r0.

consequence_for_extension_timing.statement: No extension rescue can be required before at least one ordinary elimination has occurred, unless the run already terminates in an earlier exact lane. Any first extension state therefore descends from a first projection whose size obeys the envelope above.

next_exact_target: Combine the first-projection envelope with remaining-variable count and canonical representation constraints to control the second ordinary stage, while structured current-v3 N^2 scouts search for an actual extension witness.
